Coverage_Description: Covers dental services (e.g., routine oral examination, fillings, extractions, root canal and other listed items) with itemized limits; Standard reimburses 80% of eligible expenses and Executive reimburses 100%; overall annual limits HK$12,500 (Standard, excluding dentures) and HK$24,000 (Executive, excluding dentures)
pricing: Annual premium table (HK$): Standard/Executive — Age 3 or below: 1,954/5,294; Age 4-18: 3,906/10,586
customer requirement: No dental check-up; no individual underwriting at enrolment
price structure: Annual payment; premium tiered by plan level and age/sex
additional informations: 1-year policy term, annual renewal, worldwide coverage, and choice of any registered dentist
